name: savvy-progress
description: Crab Office: a live panel of your subagents beside the chat, with a pixel office where they work and a day and night cycle, plus a progress bar above the prompt for /savvy-flow. It opens with each new chat; /crab-office or typing "open crab office" opens it. A fork of johnnyvizz's savvy-progress, keeping its plugin id.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, ru or he (Hebrew, drawn right to left)

autoOpen.title: Open the agents panel
autoOpen.description: savvy: when a savvy-flow worker starts or a plan is reported; any: also when any other subagent starts

openAtStart.title: Open the Crab Office when a chat starts
openAtStart.description: yes: every new chat opens the Crab Office; no: it opens only when asked, or by autoOpen

barAtStart.title: Show the progress bar from the start
barAtStart.description: yes: the bar above the prompt shows from the start of each chat, counting the agents; no: it shows only while a flow reports progress

leadName.title: Lead crab's name
leadName.description: The name of the main session's crab, at the top of the list and at the office's front desk
